terms.label: Agent
terms.comment: A resource that acts or has the power to act.

terms.label: Agent Class
terms.comment: A group of agents.

terms.label: Bibliographic Resource
terms.comment: A book, article, or other documentary resource.

terms.label: File Format
terms.comment: A digital resource format.

terms.label: Frequency
terms.comment: A rate at which something recurs.

terms.label: Jurisdiction
terms.comment: The extent or range of judicial, law enforcement, or other authority.

terms.label: License Document
terms.comment: A legal document giving official permission to do something with a resource.

terms.label: Linguistic System
terms.comment: A system of signs, symbols, sounds, gestures, or rules used in communication.

terms.label: Location
terms.comment: A spatial region or named place.

terms.label: Location, Period, or Jurisdiction
terms.comment: A location, period of time, or jurisdiction.

terms.label: Media Type
terms.comment: A file format or physical medium.

terms.label: Media Type or Extent
terms.comment: A media type or extent.

terms.label: Method of Accrual
terms.comment: A method by which resources are added to a collection.

terms.label: Method of Instruction
terms.comment: A process that is used to engender knowledge, attitudes, and skills.

terms.label: Period of Time
terms.comment: An interval of time that is named or defined by its start and end dates.

terms.label: Physical Medium
terms.comment: A physical material or carrier.

terms.label: Physical Resource
terms.comment: A material thing.

terms.label: Policy
terms.comment: A plan or course of action by an authority, intended to influence and determine decisions, actions, and other matters.

terms.label: Provenance Statement
terms.comment: Any changes in ownership and custody of a resource since its creation that are significant for its authenticity, integrity, and interpretation.

terms.label: Rights Statement
terms.comment: A statement about the intellectual property rights (IPR) held in or over a resource, a legal document giving official permission to do something with a resource, or a statement about access rights.

terms.label: Size or Duration
terms.comment: A dimension or extent, or a time taken to play or execute.

terms.label: Standard
terms.comment: A reference point against which other things can be evaluated or compared.

terms.label: Abstract
terms.comment: A summary of the resource.

terms.label: Access Rights
terms.comment: Information about who access the resource or an indication of its security status.

terms.label: Accrual Method
terms.comment: The method by which items are added to a collection.

terms.label: Accrual Periodicity
terms.comment: The frequency with which items are added to a collection.

terms.label: Accrual Policy
terms.comment: The policy governing the addition of items to a collection.

terms.label: Alternative Title
terms.comment: An alternative name for the resource.

terms.label: Audience
terms.comment: A class of agents for whom the resource is intended or useful.

terms.label: Date Available
terms.comment: Date that the resource became or will become available.

terms.label: Bibliographic Citation
terms.comment: A bibliographic reference for the resource.

terms.label: Conforms To
terms.comment: An established standard to which the described resource conforms.

terms.label: Contributor
terms.comment: An entity responsible for making contributions to the resource.

terms.label: Coverage
terms.comment: The spatial or temporal topic of the resource, spatial applicability of the resource, or jurisdiction under which the resource is relevant.

terms.label: Date Created
terms.comment: Date of creation of the resource.

terms.label: Creator
terms.comment: An entity responsible for making the resource.

terms.label: Date
terms.comment: A point or period of time associated with an event in the lifecycle of the resource.

terms.label: Date Accepted
terms.comment: Date of acceptance of the resource.

terms.label: Date Copyrighted
terms.comment: Date of copyright of the resource.

terms.label: Date Submitted
terms.comment: Date of submission of the resource.

terms.label: Description
terms.comment: An account of the resource.

terms.label: Audience Education Level
terms.comment: A class of agents, defined in terms of progression through an educational or training context, for which the described resource is intended.

terms.label: Extent
terms.comment: The size or duration of the resource.

terms.label: Format
terms.comment: The file format, physical medium, or dimensions of the resource.

terms.label: Has Format
terms.comment: A related resource that is substantially the same as the pre-existing described resource, but in another format.

terms.label: Has Part
terms.comment: A related resource that is included either physically or logically in the described resource.

terms.label: Has Version
terms.comment: A related resource that is a version, edition, or adaptation of the described resource.

terms.label: Identifier
terms.comment: An unambiguous reference to the resource within a given context.

terms.label: Instructional Method
terms.comment: A process, used to engender knowledge, attitudes and skills, that the described resource is designed to support.

terms.label: Is Format Of
terms.comment: A pre-existing related resource that is substantially the same as the described resource, but in another format.

terms.label: Is Part Of
terms.comment: A related resource in which the described resource is physically or logically included.

terms.label: Is Referenced By
terms.comment: A related resource that references, cites, or otherwise points to the described resource.

terms.label: Is Replaced By
terms.comment: A related resource that supplants, displaces, or supersedes the described resource.

terms.label: Is Required By
terms.comment: A related resource that requires the described resource to support its function, delivery, or coherence.

terms.label: Is Version Of
terms.comment: A related resource of which the described resource is a version, edition, or adaptation.

terms.label: Date Issued
terms.comment: Date of formal issuance of the resource.

terms.label: Language
terms.comment: A language of the resource.

terms.label: License
terms.comment: A legal document giving official permission to do something with the resource.

terms.label: Mediator
terms.comment: An entity that mediates access to the resource.

terms.label: Medium
terms.comment: The material or physical carrier of the resource.

terms.label: Date Modified
terms.comment: Date on which the resource was changed.

terms.label: Provenance
terms.comment: A statement of any changes in ownership and custody of the resource since its creation that are significant for its authenticity, integrity, and interpretation.

terms.label: Publisher
terms.comment: An entity responsible for making the resource available.

terms.label: References
terms.comment: A related resource that is referenced, cited, or otherwise pointed to by the described resource.

terms.label: Relation
terms.comment: A related resource.

terms.label: Replaces
terms.comment: A related resource that is supplanted, displaced, or superseded by the described resource.

terms.label: Requires
terms.comment: A related resource that is required by the described resource to support its function, delivery, or coherence.

terms.label: Rights
terms.comment: Information about rights held in and over the resource.

terms.label: Rights Holder
terms.comment: A person or organization owning or managing rights over the resource.

terms.label: Source
terms.comment: A related resource from which the described resource is derived.

terms.label: Spatial Coverage
terms.comment: Spatial characteristics of the resource.

terms.label: Subject
terms.comment: A topic of the resource.

terms.label: Table Of Contents
terms.comment: A list of subunits of the resource.

terms.label: Temporal Coverage
terms.comment: Temporal characteristics of the resource.

terms.label: Title
terms.comment: A name given to the resource.

terms.label: Type
terms.comment: The nature or genre of the resource.

terms.label: Date Valid
terms.comment: Date (often a range) of validity of a resource.
